{{Top|leg}}
'''Farnican chime-paintings''' were a form of mixed media artwork produced by incorporating musical, painting, and sculpture elements. [[Idyll (painting)|''Idyll'']] was a Farnican chime-painting thought to have been destroyed but eventually recovered from [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] after [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] defeat.
